identifier every account has — a phone-only signup has none — so an

CheckPermissions evaluates one or more fine-grained permission checks
("does the subject have <relation> on <object>?") in a single call and
returns one result per check, in order. The subject defaults to the
authenticated caller; an explicit `user` is honored only for super-admins
or when it equals the caller's own subject. Fail-closed.

DeactivateAccount soft-deletes the caller's account and revokes all
refresh tokens as a side effect. OAuth has no concept of account
deactivation; this is the typed equivalent of SCIM PATCH active=false.

EmailOtpMfaSetup sends a one-time code to the caller's own email and
creates an unverified email-OTP MFA enrollment. Dual-mode permissions:
(a) an authenticated caller (bearer token) — the settings-screen action
for an ALREADY-logged-in user adding a second factor; the request body is
unused in this mode. (b) a caller in the withheld first-time-offer
state, with no bearer token yet — identified by the MFA session cookie
plus email/phone_number, same pattern as SkipMfaSetup. Either mode
reuses the same underlying Authenticator row once VerifyOtp marks it
verified.

ListPermissions enumerates what the subject can access. With both
`relation` and `object_type` set it answers "which <object_type>s can I
<relation>?"; either or both filters may be omitted to enumerate every
matching (type, relation) pair of the active model. Results are capped;
`truncated` reports when more permissions exist. Subject resolution
follows the same rules as CheckPermissions.

LockMfa records that the caller lost access to their only MFA
factor(s). Only allowed when the caller has NO verified Email/SMS OTP
fallback enrolled — if one exists, use it instead of locking. Does not
issue a token; the account requires admin recovery afterward.
Login authenticates with email/phone + password.

Logout ends the caller's current session. POST, not GET: logout mutates
server state (clears the session) and is audit-logged, so it must not be
a "safe" method per RFC 9110 §9.2.1 — GET would also expose it to CSRF.

MagicLinkLogin dispatches a passwordless email link. The clicked link
hits the existing /verify_email browser handler.

get.summary: Meta returns server feature flags. No auth required.

post.summary: Revoke invalidates a refresh token. Typed mirror of RFC 7009.

Session returns the AuthResponse bound to the caller's session cookie only.
NOT exposed as an MCP tool — SessionResponse carries access_token,
refresh_token, id_token, authenticator_secret, and recovery codes,
none of which should land in an LLM transcript. (Security audit C1.)

Signup registers a new user. Public; requires sign-up enabled in config.
Returns AuthResponse with tokens + (browser callers) Set-Cookie headers.

SkipMfaSetup completes an in-progress, token-withheld MFA offer by
recording that the caller explicitly declined it, then issues the
access token that was withheld. Identified by the MFA session cookie
(set when the offer screen was returned) plus email/phone_number to
resolve the pending user — same identification pattern as VerifyOtp.
Fails with FAILED_PRECONDITION if MFA is organization-enforced
(enforce-mfa) — enforcement is never skippable.

SmsOtpMfaSetup sends a one-time code to the caller's own phone number
and creates an unverified SMS-OTP MFA enrollment. Same dual-mode
permissions and relationship to VerifyOtp as EmailOtpMfaSetup.

TotpMfaSetup generates a fresh TOTP secret, QR image and recovery codes and
creates an unverified TOTP enrollment. Same dual-mode permissions as
EmailOtpMfaSetup / SmsOtpMfaSetup: an authenticated caller (bearer token)
adding a second factor from the settings screen, or a caller in the
withheld first-time-offer state identified by the MFA session cookie plus
email/phone_number. The enrollment becomes active only once VerifyOtp is
called with is_totp=true.

WebauthnCredentials lists the authenticated caller's own passkeys.
Requires authentication.

WebauthnDeleteCredential deletes one of the authenticated caller's own
passkeys by id. Requires authentication.

WebauthnLoginOptions begins a passkey login ceremony and returns
JSON-encoded PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions. Usernameless (discoverable
credential) when email is omitted.
WebauthnLoginVerify verifies a passkey assertion and logs the user in.

WebauthnRegistrationOptions begins a passkey registration ceremony and
returns JSON-encoded PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions. email /
phone_number are used only on the MFA-session-cookie path to resolve which
user is enrolling; they are ignored for a bearer-authenticated caller.

WebauthnRegistrationVerify verifies the attestation and stores the passkey.
Returns AuthResponse: access_token is set only on the MFA-session-cookie
enrollment path (which completes a login); an ordinary settings-page caller
gets a message-only response.

authorizerv1AdminMeta.description: AdminMeta mirrors model.AdminMeta exactly (no version field).

authorizerv1Meta.description:
Meta mirrors the GraphQL Meta type — server feature flags + provider
availability, returned by the Meta query.

email.description: Either email or phone_number is always present.

app_data.description: Free-form key/value bag — same as GraphQL `app_data: Map`.

has_skipped_mfa_setup_at.description: Mirrors User.has_skipped_mfa_setup_at in GraphQL. 0 means never skipped.

mfa_locked_at.description: Mirrors User.mfa_locked_at in GraphQL. 0 means not locked.

authorizerv1User.description:
User mirrors the GraphQL User type. Returned by Profile and embedded in
AuthResponse.

protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

v1AddEmailTemplateRequest.description:
AddEmailTemplateRequest mirrors model.AddEmailTemplateRequest. design is
optional.

roles.description: roles defaults to an empty set when omitted.

allowed_subjects.description: allowed_subjects: comma-separated exact subject allow-list. Omitted = deny-all.

enable_token_review.description:
enable_token_review turns on online Kubernetes TokenReview validation.
kubernetes_api_server_url is required (https) when this is true.

v1AddTrustedIssuerRequest.description:
AddTrustedIssuerRequest mirrors model.AddTrustedIssuerRequest. jwks_url,
subject_claim, and spiffe_refresh_hint_seconds are optional; subject_claim
defaults to "sub" when unset.

v1AddWebhookRequest.description:
AddWebhookRequest mirrors model.AddWebhookRequest. event_description is
optional; when unset it defaults to the event name with dots replaced by
spaces.

v1AppData.description:
AppData is a free-form key/value bag stored against a user. Mirrors the
GraphQL `Map` scalar. Values are JSON-typed (string, number, bool, null,
nested object, nested array) to match what the existing storage layer
accepts.

v1AuditLogsRequest.description:
AuditLogsRequest mirrors model.ListAuditLogRequest. All filter fields are
optional; when unset no filtering is applied for that field.

authenticator_scanner_image.description:
TOTP enrolment artifacts (populated only when this AuthResponse
initiates TOTP setup; one-time, never re-shown).

v1AuthResponse.description:
AuthResponse mirrors the GraphQL AuthResponse type. Returned (wrapped) by
every method that produces a session: Signup, Login, MagicLinkLogin,
VerifyEmail, VerifyOtp, Session.

checks.description: The checks to evaluate; at least one, at most 100.

user.description:
Optional explicit subject ("type:id", or a bare id treated as
"user:<id>"). Honored only for super-admins or when it equals the
caller's own token subject; anything else is rejected.

results.description: One result per supplied check, in order.

client_id.description:
client_id is the public OAuth identifier presented at the authorize/token
endpoints, distinct from id (internal surrogate key).

v1Client.description:
Client mirrors model.Client field-for-field. The client
secret is deliberately ABSENT (matching the GraphQL type): it is surfaced
exactly once, only via CreateClientResponse.client_secret, and is
never returned by any get/list/update path.

v1CreateClientRequest.description:
CreateClientRequest mirrors model.CreateClientRequest.
description is optional; allowed_scopes must be non-empty (an empty scope set
is DENY-ALL and is rejected by the service layer).

v1CreateClientResponse.description:
CreateClientResponse carries the created service account plus the
plaintext client_secret, returned exactly once. This is the ONLY admin
message with a secret field; RotateClientSecret reuses it.

issuer_url.description: issuer_url is the upstream IdP issuer (its OIDC discovery base).

client_id.description:
client_id / client_secret are the credentials Authorizer holds AT the
upstream IdP. The secret is stored encrypted and never returned.

scopes.description: scopes is space-separated. Defaults to "openid profile email" when omitted.

redirect_uri.description:
redirect_uri registered at the upstream IdP. Derived from the request host
when omitted.

idp_entity_id.description:
idp_entity_id is matched against the assertion Issuer. Globally unique
across all trusted issuers.

idp_sso_url.description: idp_sso_url is the IdP Single Sign-On endpoint (HTTP-Redirect binding).

idp_certificate.description:
idp_certificate is the IdP X.509 signing certificate (PEM). Assertion
signatures are validated ONLY against this certificate.

name.description: name must be a unique, URL-safe slug.

v1CreateSamlServiceProviderRequest.description:
CreateSamlServiceProviderRequest mirrors model.CreateSAMLServiceProviderRequest.
sp_cert_pem, name_id_format, mapped_attributes, and allow_idp_initiated are
optional.

v1CreateScimEndpointResponse.description:
CreateScimEndpointResponse carries the endpoint plus its plaintext bearer
token, returned ONCE at creation and ONCE at rotation. Only the bcrypt hash
is persisted; the token can never be retrieved again.

v1DeleteClientRequest.description:
DeleteClientRequest mirrors model.ClientRequest (a single
service account id). Kept distinct from GetClientRequest and
RotateClientSecretRequest per buf's one-message-per-RPC rule.

v1DeleteEmailTemplateRequest.description:
DeleteEmailTemplateRequest mirrors model.DeleteEmailTemplateRequest (a single
email template id).

v1DeleteOrgOidcConnectionRequest.description:
DeleteOrgOidcConnectionRequest / GetOrgOidcConnectionRequest look the
connection up by id OR org_id (supply exactly one) — the service rejects a
request that names neither, and rejects an org_id that disagrees with the
loaded row's owner.

v1DeleteSamlServiceProviderRequest.description:
DeleteSamlServiceProviderRequest mirrors model.SAMLServiceProviderRequest (a
single SP id). Kept distinct from GetSamlServiceProviderRequest per buf's
one-message-per-RPC rule.

v1DeleteTrustedIssuerRequest.description:
DeleteTrustedIssuerRequest mirrors model.TrustedIssuerRequest (a single
trusted issuer id). Kept distinct from GetTrustedIssuerRequest per buf's
one-message-per-RPC rule.

v1DeleteUserRequest.description:

string, so reusing tag 1 would let an old client's email decode silently as
an id: wire-compatible, semantically wrong, and pointed at a delete. Reserving
makes an old client fail loudly instead.

v1DeleteWebhookRequest.description:
DeleteWebhookRequest mirrors model.WebhookRequest (a single webhook id). It is
kept distinct from GetWebhookRequest per buf's one-message-per-RPC rule.

email.description:
Only used in the MFA-session-cookie mode (a caller in the withheld
first-time-offer state, with no bearer token yet) to resolve which
user's MFA session cookie this is — same pattern as SkipMfaSetupRequest
/ LockMfaRequest. Ignored when the caller has a valid bearer
token/session, which already identifies the user.

v1EnableAccessRequest.description:
EnableAccessRequest mirrors model.UpdateAccessRequest (a single user id). It
is kept distinct from RevokeAccessRequest per buf's one-message-per-RPC rule.

v1FgaDeleteTuplesRequest.description:
FgaDeleteTuplesRequest mirrors model.FgaWriteTuplesInput (same shape as a
write; the tuples to remove).

v1FgaModel.description:
FgaModel is a fine-grained authorization model: its id and DSL form. Mirrors
model.FgaModel field-for-field. An empty model (both fields empty) is the
valid "no model written yet" state.

v1FgaReadTuplesRequest.description:
FgaReadTuplesRequest mirrors model.FgaReadTuplesInput. All filter fields are
optional; an empty filter reads all tuples (paginated).

v1FgaRelationInput.description:
FgaRelationInput is a (relation, object) requirement evaluated against the
authenticated caller during Session / ValidateJwtToken / ValidateSession.
AND semantics, fail-closed. Mirrors the GraphQL FgaRelationInput type.

v1FgaResetRequest.description: FgaResetRequest takes no parameters; the whole store is reset.

v1FgaTuple.description:
FgaTuple is one persisted relationship tuple returned by FgaReadTuples.
Mirrors model.FgaTuple field-for-field (the read shape; writes use the shared
FgaTupleInput).

v1FgaTupleInput.description:
FgaTupleInput is one relationship tuple supplied as request-scoped context
for a permission check; contextual tuples are never persisted. Mirrors the
GraphQL FgaTupleInput type.

v1FgaWriteTuplesRequest.description:
FgaWriteTuplesRequest mirrors model.FgaWriteTuplesInput, reusing the shared
FgaTupleInput message.

should_show_mobile_otp_screen.description: For SMS-driven flows the UI may need to render an OTP entry screen.

v1GetClientRequest.description:
GetClientRequest mirrors model.ClientRequest (a single service
account id). Kept distinct from DeleteClientRequest and
RotateClientSecretRequest per buf's one-message-per-RPC rule.

v1GetSamlServiceProviderRequest.description:
GetSamlServiceProviderRequest mirrors model.SAMLServiceProviderRequest (a
single SP id). Kept distinct from DeleteSamlServiceProviderRequest per buf's
one-message-per-RPC rule.

v1GetTrustedIssuerRequest.description:
GetTrustedIssuerRequest mirrors model.TrustedIssuerRequest (a single trusted
issuer id). Kept distinct from DeleteTrustedIssuerRequest per buf's
one-message-per-RPC rule.

v1GetWebhookRequest.description:
GetWebhookRequest mirrors model.WebhookRequest (a single webhook id). It is
kept distinct from DeleteWebhookRequest per buf's one-message-per-RPC rule.

v1ImportSamlSpMetadataRequest.description:
ImportSamlSpMetadataRequest mirrors model.ImportSAMLSPMetadataRequest. The
metadata is pasted XML — NOT a URL; no remote fetch is performed.

v1InviteMembersRequest.description:
InviteMembersRequest mirrors model.InviteMemberRequest. redirect_uri is
optional; when unset the configured app URL is used.

v1InviteMembersResponse.description:
InviteMembersResponse mirrors model.InviteMembersResponse (a message plus the
list of newly invited users).

user.description: Optional explicit subject; same trust rules as CheckPermissionsRequest.

objects.description: Distinct fully-qualified object ids the subject can access.

permissions.description:
The (object, relation) detail — relevant when no relation filter was
supplied.

truncated.description:
True when the result was capped (1000 entries) and more permissions
exist.

email.description:
Either email or phone_number is required, to resolve which user's MFA
session cookie this is — same pattern as SkipMfaSetupRequest.

v1OrgDomain.description:
OrgDomain mirrors the GraphQL OrgDomain type. verified_at is unset until the
DNS challenge succeeds (or a super-admin adds it pre-verified).

record_name.title: record_name is the DNS name to create, e.g. _authorizer-challenge.acme.com

record_value.title:
record_value is the exact TXT value to publish, e.g.
authorizer-domain-verification=<token>

v1OrgDomainChallenge.description:
OrgDomainChallenge is the DNS TXT record the caller must publish to prove
ownership of the domain.

roles.description: roles is the set of per-organization roles granted to this member.

v1OrgMember.description:
OrgMember mirrors the GraphQL OrgMember type. email/given_name/family_name
are resolved from the user store for display and are blank when the
referenced user no longer exists.

sso_client_id.description: sso_client_id is the client_id Authorizer uses AT the upstream IdP.

v1OrgOidcConnection.description:
OrgOidcConnection mirrors the GraphQL OrgOIDCConnection type. The upstream
client secret is stored encrypted and never returned.

idp_entity_id.description: idp_entity_id is the upstream IdP entity ID (the assertion Issuer).

idp_sso_url.description: idp_sso_url is the IdP Single Sign-On endpoint the AuthnRequest is sent to.

sp_entity_id.description:
sp_entity_id / acs_url are the SP identity Authorizer advertises for this
org. Empty means "derived from the request host".

attribute_mapping.description: attribute_mapping is JSON mapping profile fields to SAML attribute names.

v1OrgSamlConnection.description:
OrgSamlConnection mirrors the GraphQL OrgSAMLConnection type. The IdP signing
certificate is stored but not returned.

name.description: name is a unique, URL-safe slug identifying the organization.

v1Organization.description: Organization mirrors the GraphQL Organization type.

next_page_token.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; empty when no more pages.

page.description: 1-based page number. Ignored when page_token is set. Default 1.

limit.description: Page size. Server enforces an upper bound (typically 100). Default 10.

page_token.description:
Opaque cursor returned by the previous List call's `next_page_token`.
Preferred for new clients (AIP-158). When set, `page` is ignored.

v1Permission.description:
Permission is one (object, relation) pair the subject holds: "subject has
`relation` on `object`". Mirrors the GraphQL Permission type.

v1PermissionCheckInput.description:
PermissionCheckInput is one permission to evaluate: "does the subject have
<relation> on <object>?". Mirrors the GraphQL PermissionCheckInput type.

v1PermissionCheckResult.description:
PermissionCheckResult is the outcome of one permission check, echoing the
checked pair so batch results are self-describing (and positionally
aligned). Mirrors the GraphQL PermissionCheckResult type.

token.description: For email flows: the token from the reset email. For SMS flows: the OTP.

v1RetireSamlIdpKeyRequest.description: RetireSamlIdpKeyRequest mirrors model.RetireSAMLIDPKeyRequest (a single key id).

v1RevokeAccessRequest.description:
RevokeAccessRequest mirrors model.UpdateAccessRequest (a single user id). It
is kept distinct from EnableAccessRequest per buf's one-message-per-RPC rule.

v1RotateClientSecretRequest.description:
RotateClientSecretRequest mirrors model.ClientRequest (a
single service account id). Kept distinct from DeleteClientRequest and
GetClientRequest per buf's one-message-per-RPC rule.

cert_pem.description: cert_pem: the self-signed X.509 signing certificate (PEM), pinned by SPs.

status.description:
status: "current" (signs new assertions), "active" (published in metadata,
not signing), or "retired" (neither).

v1SamlIdpKey.description:
SamlIdpKey mirrors model.SAMLIDPKey. The private key is NEVER projected — only
the certificate and rotation status.

entity_id.description: entity_id: the SP entity ID (the AuthnRequest Issuer and assertion Audience).

acs_url.description:
acs_url: the SP Assertion Consumer Service URL — the only place assertions
are POSTed.

sp_cert_pem.description: sp_cert_pem: the SP's optional X.509 signing certificate (PEM).

name_id_format.description: name_id_format: SAML NameID format for the Subject (default emailAddress).

mapped_attributes.description: mapped_attributes: JSON mapping profile fields to emitted SAML attribute names.

allow_idp_initiated.description: allow_idp_initiated: whether unsolicited IdP-initiated SSO is permitted.

v1SamlServiceProvider.description:
SamlServiceProvider mirrors model.SAMLServiceProvider field-for-field. It is a
downstream SAML 2.0 SP that Authorizer (acting as the IdP) issues signed
assertions to. Optional pointer fields collapse to zero values on the wire.

v1SamlSpMetadataParseResult.description:
SamlSpMetadataParseResult mirrors model.SAMLSPMetadataParseResult. It does NOT
create a record — it returns fields to prefill a create call.

v1ScimEndpoint.description:
ScimEndpoint mirrors the GraphQL ScimEndpoint type. The bearer token is never
carried here — only CreateScimEndpointResponse returns it, once.

required_relations.title:
Optional fine-grained authorization gate: each (relation, object) is
checked against the authenticated caller with AND semantics, fail-closed.
Requires fine-grained authorization enabled

email.description:
Either email or phone_number is required, to resolve which user's MFA
session cookie this is.
Same dual-mode identification semantics as EmailOtpMfaSetupRequest.

v1TestEndpointRequest.description:
TestEndpointRequest mirrors model.TestEndpointRequest. event_description is
optional and unused by the test payload but accepted for parity.

email.description:
Only used in the MFA-session-cookie mode (a caller in the withheld
first-time-offer state, with no bearer token yet) to resolve which user's
MFA session cookie this is — same pattern as EmailOtpMfaSetupRequest.
Ignored when the caller has a valid bearer token/session.

allowed_subjects.description: allowed_subjects: comma-separated exact subject allow-list. Empty = deny-all.

enable_token_review.description: enable_token_review activates online Kubernetes TokenReview validation.

kubernetes_api_server_url.description: kubernetes_api_server_url is the API server called for TokenReview (https).

v1TrustedIssuer.description:
TrustedIssuer mirrors model.TrustedIssuer field-for-field. It references its
parent via service_account_id (not app_id). Optional pointer fields collapse
to zero values on the wire.

v1TrustedIssuersRequest.description:
TrustedIssuersRequest mirrors model.ListTrustedIssuersRequest.
service_account_id is optional; when unset issuers for all accounts are
returned.

v1UpdateClientRequest.description:
UpdateClientRequest mirrors model.UpdateClientRequest.
Nullable GraphQL inputs use proto3 `optional`. allowed_scopes, when non-empty,
replaces the scope set; the service rejects a set that normalizes to empty.

v1UpdateEmailTemplateRequest.description:
UpdateEmailTemplateRequest mirrors model.UpdateEmailTemplateRequest. Nullable
GraphQL inputs use proto3 `optional` so an unset field is distinguishable from
an empty value.

client_secret.description: Supplying client_secret rotates it; omitting leaves the stored secret intact.

idp_certificate.description:
Supplying idp_certificate replaces it; omitting leaves the stored
certificate intact.

is_multi_factor_auth_enabled.description:
optional: absent means "leave MFA unchanged"; present false explicitly
disables MFA. A non-optional bool would make every partial update send
false and silently disable MFA.

v1UpdateSamlServiceProviderRequest.description:
UpdateSamlServiceProviderRequest mirrors model.UpdateSAMLServiceProviderRequest.
Nullable GraphQL inputs use proto3 `optional` so an unset field is
distinguishable from an empty value.

allowed_subjects.description: allowed_subjects: comma-separated exact subject allow-list. Empty = deny-all.

enable_token_review.description:
enable_token_review / kubernetes_api_server_url: when the effective
enable_token_review is true, kubernetes_api_server_url must be a non-empty
https URL.

v1UpdateTrustedIssuerRequest.description:
UpdateTrustedIssuerRequest mirrors model.UpdateTrustedIssuerRequest. Nullable
GraphQL inputs use proto3 `optional` so an unset field is distinguishable from
an empty value.

reset_mfa.description:
Mirrors UpdateUserRequest.reset_mfa in GraphQL — see schema.graphqls'
doc comment on that field for exact semantics (clears mfa_locked_at,
is_multi_factor_auth_enabled, has_skipped_mfa_setup_at, deletes all
authenticators/passkeys).

v1UpdateUserRequest.description:
UpdateUserRequest mirrors model.UpdateUserRequest. Nullable GraphQL inputs use
proto3 `optional` so an unset field is distinguishable from an empty value
(e.g. clearing a name vs leaving it untouched, or email_verified=false).

v1UpdateWebhookRequest.description:
UpdateWebhookRequest mirrors model.UpdateWebhookRequest. Nullable GraphQL
inputs use proto3 `optional` so an unset field is distinguishable from an
empty value.

v1UserOrganization.description:
UserOrganization pairs an organization with the caller-supplied user's roles
in it.

v1UserRequest.description: UserRequest fetches a single user by id or email; at least one must be set.

query.description:
query is an optional case-insensitive substring filter matched against
email, given_name, family_name and nickname. Empty means no filter.

required_relations.description: Optional fine-grained authorization gate (AND semantics, fail-closed).
Optional fine-grained authorization gate (AND semantics, fail-closed).

email.description: Exactly one of email / phone_number is required.

v1WebauthnCredentialInfo.description:
WebauthnCredentialInfo describes one stored passkey. Mirrors the GraphQL
WebauthnCredentialInfo type.

email.description: Omit for a usernameless (discoverable credential) ceremony.

options.description:
JSON-encoded PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions to pass to
navigator.credentials.get().

state.description: OAuth authorize state to continue an in-progress authorization, if any.

credential.description:
JSON-encoded PublicKeyCredential assertion response from
navigator.credentials.get().

email.description:
Used only on the MFA-session-cookie enrollment path to resolve the user;
ignored for a bearer-authenticated caller.

options.description:
JSON-encoded PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions to pass to
navigator.credentials.create().

name.description: Optional human label for the passkey (e.g. "MacBook Touch ID").

credential.description:
JSON-encoded PublicKeyCredential attestation response from
navigator.credentials.create().

email.description:
email / phone_number / state are used only on the MFA-session-cookie
enrollment path; ignored for an ordinary bearer-authenticated caller.

v1Webhook.description:
Webhook mirrors model.Webhook field-for-field. headers is a free-form JSON
object (reusing the shared AppData wrapper around google.protobuf.Struct).

v1WebhookLogsRequest.description:
WebhookLogsRequest mirrors model.ListWebhookLogRequest. webhook_id is
optional; when unset logs for all webhooks are returned.
